meta.title: Cookie Policy — ResearchChem.uk
meta.description: How ResearchChem.uk uses cookies and similar technologies on its website, in accordance with UK GDPR and PECR.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, remember your preferences, and provide information to website owners. This policy explains how ResearchChem.uk uses cookies and how you can control them.

sections.heading: 2. Legal Basis
sections.body: We use cookies in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR). Essential cookies are placed on the basis of legitimate interest. Non-essential cookies are only placed with your explicit consent, which you can give or withdraw via the cookie banner on your first visit.

sections.heading: 3. Essential Cookies
sections.body: These cookies are strictly necessary for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They include: session cookies (to maintain your shopping cart and login state), security cookies (to protect against cross-site request forgery), and load-balancing cookies. No personal data is shared with third parties via essential cookies.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics Cookies (Optional)
sections.body: With your consent, we use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website — for example, which pages are visited most, how long visitors stay, and where they come from. This data is anonymised and aggregated. It helps us improve the site experience. You can decline these cookies without affecting your ability to use the site.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies We Do Not Use
sections.body: We do not use advertising cookies, retargeting cookies, social media tracking cookies, or any cookies that build profiles of individual users for commercial purposes. We do not sell cookie data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Cookie Duration
sections.body: Essential session cookies expire when you close your browser. Preference cookies (such as your cookie consent choice and age verification) are stored for 12 months. Analytics cookies, where accepted, are stored for up to 13 months in line with ICO guidance.

sections.heading: 7. Managing Your Cookie Preferences
sections.body: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clearing your browser's local storage or cookies and revisiting the site — the consent banner will reappear. You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the site.

sections.heading: 8. Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Where we use third-party services (such as payment processors), those services may set their own cookies subject to their own privacy and cookie policies. We do not control third-party cookies and recommend reviewing the relevant third-party policies.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legislation, or our practices. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: For any questions about our use of cookies, please contact privacy@research-chem.uk or visit our Privacy Policy page for full details of how we handle your personal data.
